$comment: Fact-check of the AI-generated 'Professional council' rows of the TWG glossary workbook (library/twg-glossary-2026-09-29/). Keyed by workbook row. build_glossary.py applies `corrections` only; nothing here has any, because no source page could be opened: the checking environment's network policy blocked every fetch, and only web search worked. So every row is `not-verified`; `suspectedIssues` and `suggestedCorrections` come from search-engine excerpts (`searchLeads`), are NOT applied, and are for the TWG to confirm against the live statute or council site. `agentVerdict` is what the checking agent proposed before this normalisation. Re-run with page fetching allowed, then move a confirmed fix into `corrections` with `evidence` (a fetched URL and quote) and set `verdict`.
method: web search only; source pages could not be fetched (environment network policy)
